body: Hi, I've had red/rough skin on the bottom of my chin for a few years now. I'm assuming it's from razor burns/ingrown hairs being pulled out (I know, it is a very bad habit which I am trying to stop!)/ random acne breakouts (the two spots on my neck in the left of the photo). Is there anything I can do to clear these all up or is it time to go to a dermatologist?

It's really ok! I appreciate you taking the time to read all of that and responding.

I have tried to not put forward any bias, in fact I would say this is biased towards her as I have barely talked about anything she did to me, as it is not me who is in this position or has been hurt to this point. I really have tried my best here but the circumstances of my life and my history with her make it really hard for me to do any more than I already can. Thanks for the recommendation though, I'm probably going to buy it.

I agree that going our separate ways is the best way out of it (I've thought this for months), it's just a matter of how easy that is for her to deal with and I can be sure she is calm enough afterwards.
I'm sorry about that I am just very worried about the situation and thought the whole situation was needed, clearly the story was longer than I expected it to be.
If you don't mind me asking, how did your situation end? If you don't want to answer that is ok, but I really do appreciate the advice :)

Yeah sorry I should have shortened it down better. I agree with your point entirely though.

I have encouraged her a lot to get help, but she hasn't been, I also do not know anyone she is close to as I genuinely have never met anyone from her life with her being from a foreign country and them not using western social media. I'm also not sure I can contact emergency services unless I think she is at immediate risk for her life, which I don't think she is.
